meta_description:
382 likes, 32 comments - nehanagar on September 16, 2026: "Paithani × Banaras
When the language of Paithani meets the looms of Banaras. 🩷

A celebration of two extraordinary Indian weaving traditions, brought together in one saree.

Woven in soft Banaras Katan silk, a delicate jaal of tiny geometric butis in gold zari travels across a rich rani pink canvas. The pallu comes alive with the opulence of zari, while traditional Paithani kadhwa butis bring an unexpected dialogue between two distinct craft legacies.

Rooted in different regions. Distinct in their identities. Yet beautifully at home together.

Paithani, reimagined through Banaras.

From the new collection by @vidhi_singhania 

#VidhiSinghania #Banarasi #IndianHandloom #IndianTextiles MadeInIndia".
